        'region': r['region']['value'],
        'date': int(r['date']),
        'value': r['value']
    })

```

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('wb_gross_savings_2001_2010.csv')
pivot = df.pivot_table(index=['country','code','region'], columns='date', values='value')

# Exclude aggregates
is_country = pivot.index.get_level_values('region') != 'Aggregates'
country_pivot = pivot[is_country]
# Require all values present and >35
complete = country_pivot[years].notnull().all(axis=1)
above35 = (country_pivot[years] > 35).all(axis=1)
qualified = country_pivot[complete & above35]
result = sorted(qualified.index.get_level_values('country'))
print(', '.join(result))
```
